retired: status layer, theatre, decorative bridges, per-module second laws and Urge twins
classification: Every declaration was read and classified by content with scripts/theatre_census.py (literal, reflexive, alias, duplicate, definitional, trivial, table and bundle statements) and by name for status vocabulary (modality, wired, green, authority, cell id, non-claim, posture, catalog pins), closed under use. Aliases, duplicates and definitional restatements were removed and their uses repointed to the theorem or definition they restated.

groups.Lean status and theatre: Status flags and enums, string identity pins, theorems restating them, rfl aliases and restatements of definitions, True-valued witnesses, read-backs of literal tables, conjunctions that only pair theorems; MoriTanaka, MoriTanakaPosture, RSBridge/ColdPath and Chem/Constants/EgoffHarnessAdversarial consisted of these. Naturality.lean (x = x and a naturality square over a discrete category) becomes MaterialClass.lean, which keeps the binder type its users need.
groups.per-module second laws (Lean/Urge): 31 Urge modules each defined their own copy of the Clausius inequality with a bridge record restating LandauerLaw.eraseSecondLaw; they are removed. A history move is now admissible when its erasure is an instance of the one predicate UMST.ProcessFamily.SecondLaw (Urge/AdmitKleisli.admissibleHistoryTransition), and provenance preservation is a theorem that consumes that hypothesis (Urge/ProvenancePreserve.postProvenance_preserves). Bridges that took a second-law proof and ignored it are removed.
groups.Urge twins (Coq, Agda, Haskell): The twins of the Urge modules selected the head of the candidate list under the name excitement_select and defined their own second laws; they are retired and Urge is Lean-primary until a twin states the same propositions as Lean.
groups.Agda second-law assumption: Agda Chem.SecondLaw carried a record SecondLawPhysics whose field asserted PhysicalSecondLaw for every process and every entropy drop, an uninhabited type: results derived under it were vacuous. The record, the modules' parameter on it and the derived witnesses are removed; Agda/Process.agda states the one predicate.
groups.open obligations moved: The B4 shrinkage obligations recorded as Lean data in Concrete/ShrinkageB4 (B2OpenObligation) are listed in Docs/FORMAL-PHYSICS-ROADMAP.md.
groups.build files: Coq makefiles generated by coq_makefile (Makefile.carrier, Makefile.chem, their .conf files and .d dependency files) and the scratch probe Lean/_check_ext.lean are removed from version control.

added.Coq/Process.v: the one second law: process family, SecondLaw, Landauer bound, tight erasure, SI bound with the exact k_B
added.Agda/Process.agda: the one second law over rationals: SecondLaw with typed refusal and sequential composition
added.Haskell/UMST/Process.hs: the one second law as an executable predicate, with six QuickCheck properties
